command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== TOOLS ==='; for x in cool-retro-term ptyxis gtk-launch desktop-file-validate update-desktop-database; do printf '%s=' "$x"; command -v "$x" || true; done
echo '=== SUDO ==='; sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo YES || echo NO
echo '=== FILES ==='; for f in "$HOME/.local/bin/free-frank-open" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-frank.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-pool-harness.desktop" "$HOME/.claude/star/daten/free-frank-icon.png" "$HOME/.config/crush/crush.json"; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %s %n' "$f"; else echo MISSING:$f; fi; done
echo '=== DESKTOPS ==='; for f in "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-frank.desktop" "$HOME/.local/share/applications/free-pool-harness.desktop"; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo ---$f; sed -n '1,140p' "$f"; }; done
echo '=== CRUSH ROUTE ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
p=os.path.expanduser('~/.config/crush/crush.json')
try:d=json.load(open(p))
except Exception as e: print('ERR',repr(e)); raise SystemExit
print('models=',d.get('models'))
print('context_paths=',d.get('options',{}).get('context_paths'))
print('global_context_paths=',d.get('options',{}).get('global_context_paths'))
print('providers=',sorted(d.get('providers',{})))
for n in ['freepool-nvidia-nemotron','freepool-groq-gptoss']:
 q=d.get('providers',{}).get(n,{})
 print(n,'base_url=',q.get('base_url'),'models=',[m.get('id') for m in q.get('models',[])])
PY
echo '=== KEY NAMES ONLY ==='; set +u; [ -f "$HOME/.last-resort/keys.env" ] && . "$HOME/.last-resort/keys.env" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for k in NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY GROQ_API_KEY MISTRAL_API_KEY OPENROUTER_API_KEY; do eval 'v=${'$k':-}'; [ -n "$v" ] && echo "$k=set" || echo "$k=unset"; done
echo '=== RUNNING ==='; ps -eo pid,args | grep -Ei 'cool-retro-term|ptyxis|harness_crush_knopf|/crush ' | grep -v grep || true
